4316-5078-7295-8171.description:

141-4454-5147.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-4454-5147.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

967-3809-4772-6495-7087.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
967-3809-4772-6495-7087.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.

851-3129-5478-6441-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

Repeat.

6752-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
6752-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
6752-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

3532-3836-5078-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3836-5078-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning a noncreature artifact with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Phyrexian Metamorph and the noncreature artifact returned in step 1, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the noncreature artifact, causing a player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.

1062-5436-5674-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-5436-5674-5870.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

813-4377-5530.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Another Round.
813-4377-5530.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

Repeat.

Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 6.

2085-4639-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
Forensic Researcher triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Kelpie Guide triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.

Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

335-479.notablePrerequisites: NOTE: This combo could result in you losing the game, please exercise caution while using it.
335-479.description:
During the end step prior to your turn, cast Ad Nauseam by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Resolve Ad Nauseam, putting the top card of your library into your hand and losing life equal to that card's mana value.
Repeat the process in step 2 until you have thirteen cards in your hand.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Triskaidekaphile triggers, causing you to win the game.
